---
title: "Notes"
subtitle: "Talks, group meetings and notes"
title-block-banner: true
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  image-placeholder: ../images/pi.png
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed: true
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<script>
// runs after load: the listing markup comes after this script in the page
window.addEventListener("load", function () {
  // Posts whose date is only known to the month (dated the 1st): show "Jun 2023"
  // in the listing instead of "Jun 1, 2023". Their own pages use date-format.
  var MONTH_ONLY = ["friedel-oscillations", "screening-rhf", "locality-interatomic",
                    "body-ordered", "locality-poster", "phd-thesis", "msc-thesis"];
  document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-post").forEach(function (post) {
    var a = post.querySelector("a[href]");
    var slug = a && (a.getAttribute("href").match(/posts\/([^/]+)\//) || [])[1];
    if (MONTH_ONLY.indexOf(slug) === -1) return;
    var d = post.querySelector(".listing-date");
    if (d) d.textContent = d.textContent.trim().replace(/\s\d{1,2},/, "");
  });

  // Year timeline in the right-hand sidebar: click a year to show only its notes
  function yearOf(el) {
    return new Date(Number(el.getAttribute("data-listing-date-sort"))).getUTCFullYear();
  }
  var posts = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-post"));
  var counts = {};
  posts.forEach(function (p) { var y = yearOf(p); counts[y] = (counts[y] || 0) + 1; });
  var years = Object.keys(counts).sort(function (a, b) { return b - a; });
  var sidebar = document.getElementById("quarto-margin-sidebar");
  if (!sidebar || !years.length) return;

  var box = document.createElement("div");
  box.className = "notes-years";
  box.innerHTML = '<h5 class="quarto-listing-category-title">Years</h5>' +
    '<ul class="notes-years-list"><li class="active" data-year="all">All <span>(' + posts.length + ')</span></li>' +
    years.map(function (y) { return '<li data-year="' + y + '">' + y + ' <span>(' + counts[y] + ')</span></li>'; }).join("") +
    "</ul>";
  sidebar.appendChild(box);

  function lists() {
    var L = window["quarto-listings"] || {};
    return Object.keys(L).map(function (k) { return L[k]; });
  }
  function setActiveYear(y) {
    box.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(function (li) { li.classList.toggle("active", li.dataset.year === y); });
  }
  box.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(function (li) {
    li.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var y = li.dataset.year;
      setActiveYear(y);
      // reset the category filter so the two don't combine confusingly
      document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category .category.active").forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove("active"); });
      var all = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category .category[data-category='']");
      if (all) all.classList.add("active");
      lists().forEach(function (list) {
        if (y === "all") list.filter();
        else list.filter(function (item) { return String(yearOf(item.elm)) === y; });
      });
    });
  });
  // picking a category resets the year selection
  document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category .category").forEach(function (c) {
    c.addEventListener("click", function () { setActiveYear("all"); });
  });
});
</script>
```
